span.normalized: We sell our products through multiple sales channels worldwide, including traditional and online retailers, wholesale distributors, direct market resellers (“DMRs”), managed service providers (“MSPs”), broadband service providers, and through our direct online store at www.netgear.com. Our main wholesale distributors include Ingram Micro, TD Synnex, and D&H Distribution Company. Our retail channel includes traditional and online retail locations both domestically and internationally, such as Amazon.com (worldwide), Best Buy, Wal-Mart, Staples, Office Depot, Target, Electra (Sweden), Fnac Darty (Europe), JB HiFi (Australia), Elkjop (Norway), and Boulanger (France).
